policy.HARD-DROP: The exact route architecture is mathematically incompatible with retained facts; do not rerun without changing the architecture.
policy.SOFT-PARK: The tested implementation failed, but the broader mathematical direction is not excluded.
policy.PROMOTE: Existing shallow evidence gives positive closing pressure and warrants deeper follow-up.
policy.UNCLEAR: Existing evidence is insufficient even to classify the tested architecture.
